reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for International Partnerships

title.narrative: Promoting and protecting civic space in Cambodia and ensuring comprehensive and inclusive participation

description.narrative: The project will address civil society priority areas of support, which include a) strengthening the monitoring of civic space threats, opportunities, and trends; b) strengthening the capacity of civil society actors to foster a better understanding of international human rights law and interaction with international human rights mechanisms; c) enhancing participation in law and policy making initiatives and facilitating more effective collaboration among civil society actors and engagement with authorities.
